name: USB Data Exfiltration
description: USB-based exfiltration tools copy targeted files, extract credential stores, or run automated data collection scripts from an unattended workstation. The Rubber Ducky and Bash Bunny can be programmed with payloads that identify and copy high-value files to USB storage in seconds. This technique requires brief physical access to a powered, logged-in workstation — a condition frequently met in office environments where employees step away briefly.

blue.det: DLP alert on USB mass storage connection; endpoint log showing file copy to USB; EDR behavioral alert.
blue.cm: USB mass storage device blocking via GPO/MDM; DLP monitoring for mass file copy; endpoint encryption; USB port blockers on sensitive workstations.
